messages:
lina_ops: Heads up — Nexa says they can consolidate 6 RMA units into a single outbound AWB to cut freight, but they flagged serial mismatches across the lot. asking if we want to consolidate or keep separate shipments for customs clarity.
vendor_nexasupply: We can ship as one AWB (saves ~30% on freight). However EU customs usually want one commercial invoice per serial range. If you consolidate we need a reconciled serial manifest signed by Redwood.
thomas_logistics: Consolidating is attractive cost-wise, but EU customs has been picky last quarter. If a single AWB delays clearance it could sit in customs for days.
matt_pm: Cost savings = nice, but lead time risk > product availability risk. What are the exact serial mismatches? small diffs or totally different SKUs?
vendor_nexasupply: Mostly same SKU (A40X-32GB) but two units show OEM SN prefix `NXA-` vs `NXP-` — looks like a firmware swap at factory. AWB we propose: `AWB 870-23456789`.
anna_solutions: Can we get scans of the units and the repair notes before authorizing consolidation? Need to confirm warranty/repair history for the `NXP-` ones.
rma_bot: RMA tickets linked: RMA-9876, RMA-9881, RMA-9883, RMA-9887, RMA-9890, RMA-9895. Current status: vendor_received (items logged) — docs missing: reconciliation_manifest.pdf
lina_ops: Upload the manifest and serial list and we'll do a quick inventory reconciliation. If vendor can provide signed manifest we can approve consolidation but we require itemized commercial invoice for customs.
vendor_nexasupply: Attaching manifest now (sent via vendor portal). Quick note: insurance only covers consolidated shipment if the declared value is correct per-item. They want per-serial declared value.
matt_pm: How big is the declared value difference? need numbers to approve insurance. Also, if customs asks for separate invoices we'll lose the consolidation benefit.
thomas_logistics: Practical option: consolidate for transport to EU gateway, then split into two domestic consignments after customs (same freight route). That reduces maritime/air legs cost but gives customs per-invoice clarity. Additional local handling fee ~€180.
anna_solutions: That seems sensible. Any ETA impact?
vendor_nexasupply: If approved, pick-up scheduled tomorrow, ETA to EU gateway 4–6 days. Splitting at gateway adds 24–36h handling. If we don't split, customs risk could add 72+ hours.
lina_ops: Sounds like split-at-gateway minimizes worst-case delay. Approve provided vendor manifest and planned gateway split, subject to invoice items listing serials.
vendor_nexasupply: Roger. We'll update invoices to list serials and declared values. Will also include repair disposition codes (repair/refurb/replace). New AWB (after gateway split) will be `AWB 870-23456789` + sub-refs.
matt_pm: Please confirm insurance coverage wording — liability for serial mismatch during transit? we need vendor acceptance in writing.
vendor_nexasupply: We accept liability during our custody. If customs or carrier causes damage in transit, we file claim. We'll email signed acceptance in 24h.
rma_bot: Note added to RMAs: consolidation-approved-by-ops (lina_ops) pending signed vendor acceptance and updated invoices.
lina_ops: Thanks. anna — please watch customs docs when they arrive and ping EU customs broker if anything looks off.
anna_solutions: On it. I'll also flag HS code `8473.30` and include origin statements.
thomas_logistics: One more: if any unit is listed as DOA vs repair, customs classification can shift — double-check RMA dispositions.
lina_ops: Good catch. vendor_nexasupply — mark RMA-9890 as DOA in the manifest if it is.
vendor_nexasupply: Updated manifest, RMA-9890 flagged DOA; invoices uploaded. Signed acceptance email queued; will post link when sent.
matt_pm: Once the signed acceptance link is posted, finance can release the consolidated shipping approval.
anna_solutions: Link received: https://vendor-portal.nexasupply.com/acceptance/1965432100 — signed by procurement contact `J. Meyer`.
lina_ops: Approved. Proceed with pick-up and gateway-split plan. We'll monitor clearance and escalate to premium brokerage if it stalls. :thumbsup:
vendor_nexasupply: Pickup confirmed for 06:00 PT tomorrow. We'll post AWB scans when available.
rma_bot: RMA thread closed for consolidation planning; monitoring open until delivery confirmed.
